svg.desc: Contours derived from Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (90 m/30 m global DSM): Contains modified Copernicus DEM GLO-30 data (c) DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and (c) Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018, provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA. Resampled to a 221 m grid, lightly smoothed, contoured every 250 m and simplified.
